class.name: MeshSplitter
class.brief_description: Splits triangle meshes without requiring manifold geometry.
class.description: Clips triangle surfaces directly against recursively generated planes. Source materials, surface names, normals, tangents, colors, UV, UV2, and CUSTOM0 through CUSTOM3 are preserved. Intersected attributes are linearly interpolated. Unlike CSG Boolean processing, this class accepts open triangle soups. Cut caps are generated when intersection segments form usable contours according to [member MeshSplitSettings.cap_mode]. Skinning, blend shapes, and non-triangle surfaces are not currently copied.

method.name: split_mesh
method.description: Recursively splits [param mesh]. Every returned mesh stores its original local-space pivot in [code]split_center[/code] metadata. Adding this position to its vertices reconstructs the source placement.
